name: HPO-RL-Bench-data
description: A dataset hosted on Hugging Face containing logged runs and data for benchmarking hyperparameter optimization (HPO) algorithms, particularly those using reinforcement learning approaches. It provides performance trajectories, configuration metadata, and associated measurements so researchers can evaluate HPO policies and compare optimization strategies. The collection is intended to enable reproducible HPO experiments and accelerate development of RL-based HPO methods.
evaluation_method: best-found validation performance (final objective) and regret / cumulative regret over evaluations
reputation: A niche community resource on Hugging Face used by researchers working on HPO and RL-based optimization; modest adoption outside that circle.
